import subprocess, sys, shutil
WT = '<worktree>'
GEN = '<records>/052-build/b2b/types-test-db-gen.ts'
orig = subprocess.run(['git', 'show', 'HEAD:types/database.ts'], cwd=WT, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
gen = open(GEN).read()
mode = sys.argv[1]
if mode == 'tables-only':
    # the generated file minus the pm_classify_document function entry
    start = gen.index('      pm_classify_document: {')
    end = gen.index('      }\n', gen.index('Returns: Json', start)) + len('      }\n')
    out = gen[:start] + gen[end:]
elif mode == 'function-only':
    # the ORIGINAL file plus only the function entry
    start = gen.index('      pm_classify_document: {')
    end = gen.index('      }\n', gen.index('Returns: Json', start)) + len('      }\n')
    entry = gen[start:end]
    # insert at the same position as in gen: before the entry that follows it in gen
    nxt = gen[end:end + 80].split('\n')[0]
    pos = orig.index(nxt, orig.index('Functions: {'))
    out = orig[:pos] + entry + orig[pos:]
elif mode == 'orig':
    out = orig
else:
    out = gen
open(WT + '/types/database.ts', 'w').write(out)
print('wrote', mode, len(out))
